الحل :
ΔG°r = Σ n ΔG°f(Products) - Σ n ΔG°f(Reactants)
ΔG°r = [12ΔG°f (CO₂) + 6 ΔG°f (H₂O) ] - [2 ΔG°f (C₆H₆) + 15 ΔG°f (O₂)]
ΔG°r = [12 × (-394) + 6 × (-237) ] - [2 × 173 + 15 × 0]
ΔG°r = [ -4728 + (-1422) ] - [ 346 ]
ΔG°r = [-6150] - [ 346 ]
ΔG°r = -6496 kJ/mol
